negative_findings.description: Every attempted automated fetch of bqk-kos.org (and its env2 mirror) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, including the About-CBK page and the Executive Board decisions page.
negative_findings.result_summary: 0 of 2 direct fetches succeeded; all CBK content in this slice was recovered via search-engine indexing of live pages and PDFs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single highest-authority source in this cell is bot-defended. Collection will need a browser-based fetcher with a realistic user agent and polite pacing; the 403 is a hypothesis of WAF filtering, NOT evidence the pages are dead — search indexing shows them live.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, machine-readable CBK page listing fit-and-proper / senior-management approvals as a separate stream was located. Such approvals appear to be embedded inside dated Executive Board decision posts alongside licensing items.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq, sr and en surfaced individual decision posts (2010, 2014, 2019, 2020) but no consolidated 'approved managers' register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move extraction must parse free-text decision posts rather than consume a structured register, which raises parsing cost and recall risk.

negative_findings.description: A standalone public register of licensed payment institutions / PSPs (separate from the combined 'Lista e institucioneve financiare' PDF) was not located; Albanian-language searching returned the regulations but no dedicated PSP register page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments actors appear folded into the general licensed-institutions PDF and into NBFI categories.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments-side leadership and organization tracking must be derived from the combined institution list plus decision posts, so a PSP-specific entity taxonomy has to be built by hand.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language coverage of CBK personnel/licensing disclosures is materially thinner than Albanian: the sr edition exists (o-cbk/cbk-odluke-odbora, organizaciona-struktura, Godišnji izveštaj) but individual dated decision posts surfaced almost exclusively in Albanian.
negative_findings.result_summary: One Serbian query returned the sr section pages and the 2025 annual report, but no sr-language individual decision notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A Serbian-only collector would miss most leadership-move events; Albanian must be the primary collection language for this cell, with sr used for confirmation and for Serb-majority-market actors.

negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language (sr) corporate communications channel was located for any Kosovo commercial bank in this cell. Serbian-language queries ('imenovanje direktor', 'saopštenje') returned only Slovenian/Serbian group-level NLB material and Wikipedia, not a sr version of any Kosovo bank site.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr-language own-channel coverage for Kosovo banks appears absent or not indexed; NLB Group (Ljubljana) is the only path to sr/sl-adjacent disclosures about a Kosovo subsidiary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The run scope mandates sr coverage; if Kosovo banks genuinely publish only in sq/en, sr-language monitoring must be redirected to parent groups and Serbian-language media rather than bank sites.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'press release' or 'media' section could be confirmed for TEB Sh.A. Kosovo, BPB beyond /news/, Banka Ekonomike, or Ziraat Bank Kosova; announcements appear mixed into general news pages or only on social channels.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Raiffeisen, ProCredit and BKT Kosova were confirmed to have a structured, separately-addressable announcements section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design cannot assume a uniform 'press room' per bank; for four of eight banks the crawler must target general news pages, governance roster pages and social channels instead.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or JSON feed was observed on any of the bank sites examined; all listings appear to be plain HTML pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Machine-readable feeds absent across the cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Every source in this cell requires HTML crawling and diffing, raising fragility and maintenance cost; snapshot-diffing of governance roster pages becomes the most reliable detection mechanism.

negative_findings.description: https://www.procreditbank-kos.com/shq/lajme/ returned HTTP 500 on a single fetch attempt, while individual item URLs under the same path and the /eng/pages/njoftime/ listing were indexed by search.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: A one-off 500 must not cause the ProCredit newsroom to be dropped from the collection plan; the deterministic liveness pass should retry both sq and eng listing paths.

negative_findings.description: Targeted sq and en searches for a recent Raiffeisen Kosovo CEO change surfaced only an existing CEO and a COO/CIO appointment; no 2025-2026 CEO succession announcement was found on any own channel.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language queries repeatedly returned English Wikipedia pages ('List of banks in Kosovo', 'Kosovska Banka', 'Banking in Kosovo') in the top results instead of the sq-language local articles being sought, across at least five distinct sq queries.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for banking conferences, speaker rosters and bank internships in Kosovo produced almost nothing Kosovo-specific. Queries on Kosovska Mitrovica / Ekonomski fakultet / bankarstvo returned Serbia-wide or unrelated academic material; no sr-language banking conference in or about Kosovo was identified.

negative_findings.description: No internship, trainee or graduate-programme page was found for TEB Sh.a. Kosovo, BKT Kosova or NLB Banka Kosovo despite targeted sq+en queries. Only the corporate sites and a group-level NLB careers page surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three of the largest Kosovo banks have no discoverable university-pipeline programme via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either these programmes exist but are published only on login-gated ATS portals / job boards / social media, or they genuinely do not run them. The distinction matters for interpreting 'no internship signal' from these banks as evidence of flat headcount plans.

negative_findings.description: The Kosova Finance Forum / Kosova Business Forum speaker pages (/speaker/ and sq /speaker-2/) were identified via search snippets but their per-edition structure, archive depth and whether past-edition rosters remain online were not established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: High-value source located; retention and archiving behaviour unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the organiser overwrites the speaker page each edition, historical title snapshots are lost and the source must be captured live each year (plus a web-archive fallback) rather than mined retrospectively.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific FINTECH conference (as distinct from general finance forums and the general-purpose KosICT technology festival) was identified. Searches in sq and en for fintech conferences in Prishtina returned Albania-based events (Bank of Albania digital banking conference, AAB) or generic tech events.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fintech-event layer for Kosovo appears to be absorbed into KFF panels and KosICT tracks rather than existing as a standalone event.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Speaker rosters for payments/fintech leadership must be extracted from panel-level detail inside broader events, which is harder to automate than a dedicated fintech-conference speaker page.

negative_findings.description: Two of the most information-dense channels for speaker/award-adjacent title data are collection-restricted: LinkedIn company and personal pages (login wall plus ToS prohibition on scraping) and Euromoney award articles (subscription paywall).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both recorded as blocked candidates rather than dropped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection design that assumes LinkedIn scraping will fail legally and technically; the pipeline must route these through analyst review or licensed access and treat the open-web mirrors (association site, winning bank press release) as the collectable substitute.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated bank-workers' or financial-sector trade union was found for Kosovo in Albanian or Serbian searches. Searches for 'sindikata e punëtorëve bankarë' and 'sindikat bankarskih radnika Kosovo' returned no such organisation, only general private-sector union coverage and individual dismissal cases.
negative_findings.result_summary: Grievance signal for banks is not channelled through a sectoral union; it appears via the Labour Inspectorate, courts, individual complainants and media instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for this cell must not wait on a bank union feed that does not exist; the inspectorate/court/registry path is the load-bearing one.

negative_findings.description: No public dataset or register of collective-redundancy notifications ('largime kolektive') filed by employers in Kosovo was located; the Labour Inspectorate publishes aggregate inspection statistics and ad-hoc notices, not case-level or employer-level redundancy filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Employer-level redundancy events must be reconstructed from complaints, judgments, registry changes and media rather than read off a register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations for coverage: the cell yields case-level anecdotes plus aggregate statistics, not a clean event feed.

negative_findings.description: Multiple independent sources (CSO monitoring reports, RFE/RL, news coverage) describe the Labour Inspectorate as under-resourced (~53 inspectors nationwide) and limited in transparency, with a documented nine-month delay against a statutory 30-day deadline in the ProCredit Bank complaints.
negative_findings.result_summary: Inspectorate output lags events substantially and is incomplete, especially for the private sector.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Timeliness assumptions for inspectorate-derived signals must be measured in quarters, not weeks; media and registry sources will usually lead it.

negative_findings.description: Employee-review platforms (Glassdoor) carry Kosovo-filtered content for at least Raiffeisen Bank International, but their terms prohibit automated collection and review lists are partly gated. No Kosovo-specific coverage was found on any local employer-review platform; none appears to exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: Review-site signal is usable only manually or under licence, and only for the international bank groups.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Constrains what would otherwise be the fastest sentiment/attrition indicator for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language searching produced rich results for bank branch closures and staff redundancies in the north and enclaves (NLB Komercijalna: branch plus nine outlets, 38 employees affected, severance/voluntary-departure programmes) but produced no Serbian-language union actor specific to Kosovo bank employees; affected staff appealed to Serbian government bodies rather than to a union.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language coverage is essential for branch-closure/redundancy signals but has no union pointer of its own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms sr-language monitoring of KoSSev/Radio KIM/Kontakt Plus is mandatory, and that the grievance route in the north is political rather than union-mediated.

negative_findings.description: The SITP labour-market barometer (sitp.rks-gov.net) and KosovaJob were identified but not fetched in this run, so their export/API capability and terms of use are unconfirmed. Neither should be recorded as live or as machine-collectable until the deterministic verification pass runs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two high-value candidates carry lower confidence pending verification.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-promising a structured financial-sector headcount series that may only exist as an on-screen dashboard.

negative_findings.description: Emerging Europe (emerging-europe.com), named in the cell definition, did not surface in any result set for Kosovo fintech/payments leadership queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries returned Fintech Times, The Recursive, KCDF and researchgate items instead; no emerging-europe.com article on Kosovo payments leadership was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The assumed aggregator may have thin or discontinued Kosovo people coverage; the cell should not depend on it without direct site-search verification.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific article from The Banker (thebanker.com) was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed query returned only tangential items (EBRD appointment via Balkan Green Energy News, Kosovo Banking Association journal, Wikipedia). The Banker's Kosovo footprint appears limited to database entries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Global trade titles are unlikely to be a primary channel for Kosovo people moves; local/association and regional newswire sources should carry the weight.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for Kosovo banking management-change analysis returned almost exclusively CBK primary documents and academic PDFs, not a regional analyst/aggregator layer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'analiza bankarski sektor Kosovo promene u upravi izveštaj Zapadni Balkan' returned CBK Godišnji Izveštaj PDFs, a Kosovo government reform-agenda PDF and a ResearchGate comparative study.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There appears to be no sr-language aggregator specialised in Kosovo bank people moves; sr coverage must be taken from CBK's own Serbian editions plus Serbian general business media (outside this cell).

negative_findings.description: SeeNews and bne IntelliNews article bodies are assumed subscription-gated but this was not tested in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only search-result snippets and section URLs were observed; no fetch of a full article body was attempted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design (headline-only vs full-text) depends on the real gate; a deterministic access test is needed before building collectors.

negative_findings.description: An Albanian-language tabloid item (paparaci.com) alleging a Kosovo bank director concealed citizenship from the CBK surfaced in sq search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found at paparaci.com; sensational outlet, single-sourced, not corroborated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Such outlets do generate real leads on fit-and-proper disputes but must never be treated as evidence; flagged as noisy, not added as a candidate for this aggregator-focused cell.

negative_findings.description: No group-level press release or ad-hoc announcement dedicated specifically to a Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo CEO/management-board appointment was found in the searches run. RBI's 2025 board-reorganisation release is group-level only.
negative_findings.result_summary: RBI publishes network-bank leadership changes inconsistently; Kosovo-unit appointments appear to surface mainly on the local Raiffeisen Kosovo governance pages rather than in group press releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for RBI/Kosovo must lean on roster diffing of raiffeisen-kosovo.com rather than expecting a group release; a release-only strategy would miss appointments.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language query for a BKT Kosova new-executive announcement ('drejtor i ri menaxhues njoftim') returned only static governance pages, no press announcement.
negative_findings.result_summary: BKT Kosova appears not to publish leadership-change press releases in a crawlable news section; only the Bordi i Drejtorëve roster page reflects changes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms roster-diff as the required method for the Çalık/BKT branch and marks BKT as a low-signal publisher for A5.

negative_findings.description: Turkish-language search for a KAP disclosure covering TEB board changes touching TEB Sh.A. Kosova returned no specific filing.
negative_findings.result_summary: KAP is the correct statutory venue and TEB entities file there, but no Kosovo-specific board disclosure was surfaced by general web search; the KAP portal itself must be queried directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Web search is a poor proxy for KAP contents; a direct KAP company-filtered query must be built into the collection plan or the TEB/BNP branch will look empty.

negative_findings.description: Serbian/BCS-language query for an NLB Group announcement of an NLB Banka Prishtina management appointment ('imenovan član uprave', 'saopštenje') returned no such release.
negative_findings.result_summary: NLB's Kosovo-unit governance communication appears to run through the local Albanian/English site and Slovene-language SEOnet filings rather than Serbian-language group releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language monitoring is low-yield for the NLB/Kosovo branch specifically; Slovene (sl) is the more productive non-local language here, which is outside the declared run language set (sq/sr/en).

negative_findings.description: No Ziraat group announcement naming a Ziraat Bank Kosova general-manager appointment was found; only the Kosovo unit's own senior-management page and group-level Turkish appointments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ziraat's group communications enumerate foreign subsidiaries but do not routinely announce Kosovo-unit management changes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Ziraat branch of this cell will depend on subsidiary roster diffing plus Turkish agency reporting, not group IR.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific payments-industry trade press, PSP-only newsletter, or acquiring/processing trade association website was found. Payments-sector employer news is scattered across general news outlets, the banking association magazine and the FIKS cluster page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq and en for payments-sector trade media returned only general news outlets and the Kosovo Banking Association magazine on Issuu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a trade-press spine, the cell must rely on aggregating many low-volume company channels, raising collection cost and the risk of missing leadership moves at small PSPs.

negative_findings.description: English-language searches for Kosovo acquiring/merchant-services vacancies were dominated by US job aggregators (ZipRecruiter, SimplyHired, Indeed) and employer-of-record marketing pages, with no genuine Kosovo payments vacancies.
negative_findings.result_summary: The query 'Kosovo payment service provider hiring acquiring merchant services jobs' returned zero Kosovo-domiciled payments vacancies; all hits were US-centric or EOR vendor content.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that English-only collection is structurally inadequate for this cell and that global aggregators must be excluded or heavily filtered to avoid polluting the signal set.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage of the Kosovo payments-employer landscape is very thin. Searches using 'platni promet', 'usluge plaćanja', 'zapošljavanje', 'oglasi za posao' and 'Severna Mitrovica' produced no Kosovo-Serb payments employer, no local job portal, and no vacancy listings — only Belgrade press on the dinar payment-traffic dispute and unrelated Serbian job ads.
negative_findings.result_summary: One relevant sr article (Vreme, on the payment-traffic ban and NLB Komercijalna branch closures); no sr-language hiring source located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The run mandates sr coverage. A structural sr blind spot means payments-related job losses/creation in northern municipalities would be detected only through Albanian or English secondary reporting, with delay and bias.

negative_findings.description: Candidate local wallet/processor brand names probed speculatively ('Sendway', 'Klix', 'MPay') returned no evidence of being Kosovo payments operators. 'Rrota' resolved to a Kosovar creative/consulting company, not a payments firm.
negative_findings.result_summary: No corroboration found; these names are NOT recorded as payments actors.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated actor map. The verified non-bank payments actor set for Kosovo currently rests on Paysera, OneFor, Swinto, Numarics, Moneta, Unioni Financiar Prishtinë and PayLink (AL-registered).

negative_findings.description: The BQK licensed-institutions page returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on direct fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on https://bqk-kos.org/mbikeqyrja-financiare/institucionet-financiare-te-licencuara-2/?lang=en; the site is clearly live (its PDFs are indexed and served).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most authoritative actor-map source needs a browser-grade fetcher. Recorded as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead.

negative_findings.description: No public careers page was located for the bank-owned acquiring arms named in the cell brief (e.g. ProCredit or Raiffeisen acquiring/merchant-services units) as separate hiring entities. Their payments roles surface only inside the parent bank's postings on KosovaJob.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments roles appear as bank departments ('Payments and Back Office Department'), not as distinct acquiring-arm employers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means the cell's 'separate legal entity' premise holds for EMIs/MTOs/processors but not for bank acquiring in Kosovo; acquiring signals must be extracted from bank job ads by role-title matching (acquiring, POS, merchant, kartela, PCI).

negative_findings.description: Neither kosovajob.com nor ofertapune.net exposes an RSS/Atom feed in its page markup, and no public API was found for either. KosovaJob additionally has no stable industry-category URL for banking - it uses company-slug pages and a search box filtering 'sipas Pozites, Qytetit, ose Industrise' whose category endpoints are not exposed in the HTML.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection must be HTML crawl + diff, not feed subscription; per-employer crawling is the only reliable banking slice on KosovaJob.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out the cheapest collection design and raises the fragility of the whole cell to site redesigns; also means listing publication dates must be inferred (e.g. from the boards' Facebook post timestamps).

negative_findings.description: portalpune.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body on direct fetch, while its tag pages are search-indexed and its Facebook page posts fresh job links daily. This is bot defence, not a dead site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as blocked/unverified, not dead; Facebook feed identified as the workaround index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive liveness pass would drop a high-volume bank-vacancy source. The 403 must be treated as a hypothesis pending a headless-browser retry.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Serbian for Kosovo bank vacancies ('konkurs za posao banka Kosovo Mitrovica oglasi posao srpski jezik'). No Kosovo-specific Serbian-language job board was found - only Serbia-wide boards (Infostud, HelloWorld, Poslovi.rs, KlikDoPosla) that carry a thin Kosovska Mitrovica location page. None of those pages surfaced an actual bank vacancy in the results reviewed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo banking vacancies exists only as a thin location filter on Serbia-wide boards.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring by Serbian-system financial institutions in northern Kosovo may be effectively invisible to this cell; the sr dimension cannot be assumed covered just because sr boards were catalogued.

negative_findings.description: Albanian job vocabulary does not distinguish Kosovo from Albania. njoftime.com and gjirafa jobs mix XK and AL listings, and the sharpest payments-role hit found ('Specialist - Departamenti i Kartave dhe Pagesave') is a Tirana vacancy. 'Bankë', 'konkurs', 'vende pune' are all high-noise on their own.
negative_findings.result_summary: Every sq query needs an XK disambiguator (city names: Prishtinë, Prizren, Pejë, Ferizaj, Gjakovë, Mitrovicë, Podujevë) or an XK-registered employer name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without geo-disambiguation the cell will silently import Albanian market signals into Kosovo org-change conclusions.

negative_findings.description: No job board in this cell was found to publish executive appointments, board changes, or departures. Boards carry vacancies only; senior roles (Head of Digital Banking, CIO, Chief Compliance Officer) were not observed advertised on the sq boards reviewed - such hires appear to be executive-search or internal.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'leadership moves' topic is largely NOT served by this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move signal must come from another cell (press releases, BQK licensing/fit-and-proper notices, LinkedIn, media). Over-relying on job boards would under-detect C-level change.

negative_findings.description: Kosovo boards remove listings after the application deadline ('skadon' / 'mbyllet sot'); no public archive of expired bank ads was found on kosovajob.com, ofertapune.net or portalpune.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: Historical vacancy series cannot be reconstructed retroactively from these boards.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The org-change signal is only available going forward, and only if the collector snapshots full ad text at discovery time. njoftime.com forum threads are the one partial exception since threads persist.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated LinkedIn company page for Banka Ekonomike sh.a. surfaced in any query, although employee profiles referencing 'Banka Ekonomike SH.A.' were indexed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Employee profiles exist but no confirmed /company/ URL was observed. Not recorded as non-existent — only as not found by search. Requires a direct in-app LinkedIn company search to confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Banka Ekonomike is a domestically-owned bank; missing its page leaves a hole in the org-change watchlist for exactly the segment least covered by international press.

negative_findings.description: Every individual role-change announcement search ('excited to announce', 'joining as', 'pozicion i ri', 'imenovan') returned only profile stubs, never the actual post.
negative_findings.result_summary: LinkedIn member posts and activity feeds are not reliably indexed by general web search and are login-gated; the highest-value signal in this cell (individual self-announcements) is not retrievable via search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core hypothesis — individuals announce moves before employers — cannot be operationalised by open-web crawling. Collection must be either a logged-in analyst workflow, LinkedIn Sales Navigator alerts, or a licensed data vendor.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific Albanian idiom for LinkedIn role-change announcements was confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries using 'pozicion i ri', 'emërohet drejtor i ri' returned no matching announcement posts; Kosovar banking professionals appear to announce moves predominantly in English on LinkedIn, with Albanian reserved for employer recruitment posts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring rules should not assume Albanian-language announcement phrasing for individual moves; Albanian keywords are however essential for employer job ads (KosovaJob, Raiffeisen Career).

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language professional-network signal for Kosovo banking is very thin.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr-language queries returned generic job boards, Wikipedia entries and a Serbia-registered NLB Komercijalna page; no Kosovo-north-specific banking LinkedIn presence was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Org change in the parallel/northern banking layer will likely be invisible in this cell and must be picked up by a different workstream (press, regulator, municipal sources).

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn alumni/university flow data (e.g. UBT, RIT Kosovo graduates into banks) could not be reached.
negative_findings.result_summary: The alumni tool is entirely behind login; no open-web proxy was found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Alumni flow was a stated sub-target of this cell; it is currently uncollectable without an authenticated workflow.

negative_findings.description: BIFIDEX, the Western Balkans joint business-registers platform, offers exactly the capability this cell wants — real-time notification when any change is recorded in the official register for a company or its authorised persons — but its published member coverage is Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia & Herzegovina (RS), North Macedonia and Albania. No Kosovo registry membership was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched for Bifidex + Kosovo; all member listings found omit Kosovo. Also noted the platform's governance is described as institutionally fragile with periods of inactivity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no off-the-shelf regional change-notification service covering Kosovo registry filings, so change detection for XK must be built in-house by diffing ARBK snapshots.

negative_findings.description: No open, bulk or machine-readable feed of Kosovo company OFFICERS/DIRECTORS/SHAREHOLDERS was found. OpenCorporates records officers, directors, shareholders and accounts as not available for the Kosovo register (Open Company Data Index score 15/100), and reporting indicates automated bulk extraction from the ARBK portal for commercial redistribution is not authorised.
negative_findings.result_summary: Officer-level data appears obtainable only per-entity, via the ARBK portal extract or paid extract brokers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring leadership change through the register will be per-entity and rate-limited, so a tightly curated watchlist (driven by the BQK licensed-institutions list) is mandatory rather than optional.

negative_findings.description: Searching in Albanian for a Kosovo beneficial-ownership register (regjistri i pronarëve përfitues) returned only ARBK's general pages and Serbia's UBO register. No dedicated public Kosovo UBO register portal was identified in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Beneficial-owner information appears to be collected by BQK during fit-and-proper assessment rather than exposed in a public searchable UBO register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ultimate ownership changes behind banks/PSPs may not be publicly observable in Kosovo; this limits the pointer value of the registry for ownership (as opposed to director) change.

negative_findings.description: The exact URL and query interface of ARBK's public company SEARCH (as opposed to the login/registration front-end at rbk.rks-gov.net and the informational site at arbk.rks-gov.net) was not pinned down in this pass, nor was it confirmed which officer fields appear in a free public result.
negative_findings.result_summary: Secondary sources state basic search is free, English-capable and account-free, but this was not established from the portal itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design (what can be diffed automatically vs what needs a paid extract) depends on this; it should be resolved by a hands-on portal walkthrough, not more searching.

negative_findings.description: Unlike many jurisdictions, no evidence was found that the Kosovo Official Gazette publishes routine COMPANY filings (director changes, statute amendments) — it appears to carry laws, regulations and state-body decisions/appointments instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: GZK is valuable for public-sector and central-bank appointments, but is unlikely to be a systematic feed of private bank/PSP director changes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-investment in gazette monitoring as a substitute for registry monitoring for commercial entities.

negative_findings.description: Sources reference downloading full Commercial Court decisions from the court's official website, but the specific decisions-publication URL on the Kosovo judiciary domain was not located in this pass; the cases are also still being migrated from manual registers into the SMIL electronic case-management system.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only aggregated third-party compilations of Commercial Court decisions were found directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Contested director removals and shareholder disputes may be visible only through the court; the canonical publication endpoint still needs to be identified.

negative_findings.description: The e-Prokurimi homepage fetch did not expose a discoverable notice-search or award-notice browse URL; only a news archive and a contracting-authority list link were resolvable. Individual notices are reachable only via opaque numeric IDs (DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=NNNNNNN).
negative_findings.result_summary: Notice-level browsing endpoint not identified from the homepage; ID-based deep links confirmed to exist. This is a hypothesis about the site structure, not evidence the search function is absent — an authenticated or JS-driven search UI very likely exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector will probably need ID enumeration, sitemap discovery or a headless-browser session rather than a simple listing crawl; effort estimate for the highest-value source in this cell should be raised accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Targeted searches for Kosovo public tenders specifically naming POS terminals, card acquiring or payment-processing services (sq: 'terminale POS', 'shërbime të procesimit të pagesave') returned no matching award notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: No POS/acquiring-specific public contract award notice was found in open web search. The closest confirmed payments-infrastructure procurement is BQK's 'TIPS Clone Connectivity Services' contract award notice (instant payments), found on bqk-kos.org.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests such procurements are either rare, bundled under generic 'shërbime bankare' or IT CPV codes, or only visible inside e-Prokurimi's search — meaning keyword monitoring must use CPV codes and broad Albanian terms, not English payments jargon.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for Kosovo public financial institutions' vacancies and tenders was heavily polluted by Republic of Serbia institutions (mfin.gov.rs, trezor.gov.rs, mup.rs) that share the exact same terminology.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one genuinely Kosovo-based sr-language public vacancy source was confirmed (Posta e Kosovës 'Javni Konkurs Za Radno Mesto'). No sr-language vacancy or tender page was confirmed on the sites of MFPT, FSDK, KCGF or Trusti, though the Public Procurement Rules require preliminary notices in Albanian, Serbian and English.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr is a mandated official language in Kosovo, so sr-language notices should exist; failing to find them via general search means the collector must go to the institution sites' sr language toggles directly. Also flags 'Ministarstvo finansija', 'Trezor', 'javne nabavke', 'konkurs' as high-noise terms requiring a site: or geographic qualifier ('Kosovo', 'Priština', 'rks-gov.net').

negative_findings.description: A plain fetch of mf.rks-gov.net (Ministry of Finance, Labour and Transfers) did not return the site's menu URLs for konkurse, prokurimi, Thesari or organizational structure.
negative_findings.result_summary: Homepage content rendered without resolvable section links; likely a JS-driven menu. Treated as unverified, not dead — the ministry site is clearly live and referenced by other official sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The ministry site needs a browser-based or sitemap-based crawl; in the interim, konkursi.rks-gov.net and kosovajob.com cover its vacancy flow.

negative_findings.description: No single official page was located that lists appointments/dismissals of senior Treasury (Thesari) officials, e.g. the Director of Treasury.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) is the likely repository for such government decisions but no appointment decision was retrieved via general search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection for Treasury will require direct querying of the GZK act database plus media monitoring, rather than a ready-made feed.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a currently branded 'EU4Kosovo' financial-sector programme with published expert calls, in Albanian ('projekt ekspert konkurs punësimi').
negative_findings.result_summary: No EU4Kosovo financial-sector project page or expert call surfaced. The 'EU4...' naming convention was confirmed in the region (e.g. EU4PFM in Montenegro seeking junior/senior non-key experts), but no Kosovo financial-sector equivalent was found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed query assumed a named programme that may not exist under that label for Kosovo; the collector should instead anchor on the EU Office in Kosovo (EEAS) and TED IPA notices rather than a programme brand.

negative_findings.description: Sought a current EBRD Kosovo bank-advisory / financial-institution consultant assignment notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kosovo EBRD consultancy notices are demonstrably published on ECEPP (roads supervision, Gjilan wastewater PIU support), but no banking/payments advisory assignment appeared in general web results — ECEPP notices are poorly indexed by search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this channel must be harvested from ECEPP directly on a schedule rather than via search engines; absence in search is not absence in the portal.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for donor/IFI financial-sector consultant notices relating to Kosovo returned essentially nothing Kosovo-specific.
negative_findings.result_summary: Terms 'oglas', 'konsultant', 'bankarski sektor', 'konkurs' pulled results from Serbia, Bosnia and Montenegro (EU4PFM, eufondovikonkursi.com) rather than Kosovo. Donor and IFI notices for Kosovo appear overwhelmingly in English and secondarily Albanian.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language monitoring for this cell should be scoped narrowly (EEAS Kosovo _sr pages, e-Prokurimi Serbian versions, North-Kosovo institutions) rather than run as broad web search, or it will generate cross-border noise.

negative_findings.description: TED was searched for Kosovo financial-sector technical-assistance notices via general web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only TED's own explanatory pages and one unrelated 2014 Kosovo education TA notice surfaced. TED notice bodies are not reliably reachable through general search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: TED must be collected via its API/bulk packages with CPV and place-of-performance filters; treating web search as the access path would systematically miss this cell's most authoritative channel.

negative_findings.description: Devex and DevelopmentAid carry the richest consolidated view of Kosovo-relevant donor consultant roles and tender history.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both gate detail behind subscriptions; only titles, organisations and partial metadata are publicly visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed if this cell is to be covered at depth; otherwise rely on primary portals and accept lag.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of https://bankassoc-kos.com/about-us/board-of-directors/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: The same site is well indexed with fresh content and other paths (/Al/komunikatat/..., /uploads/files/...) resolve in search results, so the 403 is almost certainly bot defence (WAF/user-agent filtering), not a dead page. Recorded as unverified-but-presumed-live; requires a headless browser or a realistic UA for collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single highest-value page in the cell. Mis-recording it as dead would silently drop the primary Kosovo bank-leadership signal from the collection plan.

negative_findings.description: AmCham Kosovo's legacy domain amchamksv.org 301-redirects to amcham.network.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.amchamksv.org/all-members/ returned 301 to https://amcham.network/. The new domain exposes tiered member directories, a committees category, board of governors and newsroom. Legacy deep links (e.g. /finance/, /financial-service/, the 2026 board-election story) still surface in search and may or may not redirect cleanly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any stored AmCham URLs from earlier runs will need rewriting; a naive liveness check on old deep links could mark good sources dead.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Kosovo association of payment service providers / e-money institutions was found in any of the three languages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Albanian ('shoqata e pagesave elektronike', 'shoqata e institucioneve të pagesave', 'PSP anëtarë') returned only the banking association, the microfinance association and the FIKS fintech community. The nearest substitute is FIKS (fintechkosovo.com), which lists founding members but publishes no board or full membership roster.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: PSPs and e-money institutions — a core part of the payments actor map — are not covered by any association directory in Kosovo. Their enumeration must come from the CBK licence register instead (a different cell), not from the association layer.

negative_findings.description: A Kosovo insurance association (Shoqata e Siguruesve të Kosovës) could not be confirmed as an active, separately-governed body with a public member/board page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian search surfaced bks-ks.org (apparently the Kosovo Insurance Bureau / Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit) rather than a member association with published committees. Not fetched in this pass; treated as a lead, not a candidate.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Insurers are adjacent buyers of payments and IT infrastructure; if a governed association exists it would add another named-executive roster to the map.

negative_findings.description: STIKK membership scale and board composition are reported inconsistently across sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: Third-party profiles state '200+ members, 90% of the ICT market' while STIKK's own about page states 'over 100 members representing over 60% of the ICT labor market'. Search snippets also showed a board chaired by Burbuqe Hashimi (3CIS) whereas the live page shows Astrit Leti (Tive) as chairman with a substantially different roster.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the board page turns over between terms and must be snapshotted with an observed-at date; also a warning never to cite association scale figures without attributing the specific source and date.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language association sources for the banking/payments sector specifically are close to non-existent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian queries ('Udruženje banaka Kosova', 'članovi upravni odbor') returned almost entirely Serbian-state institutions (Udruženje banaka Srbije, PKS) rather than Kosovo bodies. The only genuinely Kosovo-relevant Serbian-language material was general business-association organising covered by KoSSev and the parallel Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Serb-majority north's financial-sector actors are not represented in any association directory reachable in Serbian; sr-language coverage for this cell will remain thin and must be met via news monitoring rather than directories.

negative_findings.description: No association-hosted job board for the Kosovo banking sector was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither SHBK, AMIK nor the chambers appear to run a sector vacancy board; only OEK's /konkurset/ and AmCham's own vacancy notices exist, and both are association-internal rather than sector-wide.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'jobs' topic cannot be served from the association layer in Kosovo; it must be sourced from bank career pages and commercial job portals (a different cell).

coverage_gaps.description: The canonical index/archive URLs for CBK Executive Board decisions and press releases were not confirmed — only individual post URLs and section paths were recovered from the search index.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-based crawl of bqk-kos.org to retrieve sitemap.xml and the WordPress category/archive pages for decisions and njoftime, then pin canonical index URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom or API endpoint for CBK decisions or vacancies was identified in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe /feed, /?feed=rss2 and category feeds on the WordPress site; if absent, build HTML diffing on the archive pages.

coverage_gaps.description: CBK's social channels (LinkedIn, Facebook, X/Twitter) — which typically announce appointments and vacancies faster than the website — were not examined in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Identify and assess official CBK social accounts as low-latency pointer sources feeding back to the authoritative decision post.

coverage_gaps.description: Decision posts were sampled from 2010, 2014, 2019 and 2020; the completeness and continuity of the archive (whether posts exist for every board meeting, and how far back) is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full archive and measure meeting-to-post coverage per year before treating absence of a post as absence of a decision.

coverage_gaps.description: CBK's financial-stability and supervision-specific periodic reports were noted only in passing; their governance/personnel content was not assessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess the Financial Stability Report and Monthly Financial System Information report for recurring organizational and supervisory-capacity disclosures.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language monitoring of Kosovo bank leadership/organization news has no confirmed own-channel source; the sr surface for this cell is effectively unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sr-language pass against Serbian-language Kosovo media (kossev.info, kosovo-online.com) and NLB Group's sl/sr disclosures, and check whether any bank offers a Serbian site variant (e.g. /srb/ or /sr/ path probing on each of the eight domains).

coverage_gaps.description: Exact news-listing and careers URLs remain unconfirmed for TEB Sh.A., Banka Ekonomike, BPB and NLB Kosovo main site; only homepages or roster pages were verified in search results.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a shallow site crawl (or sitemap.xml / robots.txt fetch) on teb-kos.com, bekonomike.com, bpbbank.com, nlb-kos.com and hr.nlb-kos.com to enumerate the sq/en news and careers paths before configuring collection.

coverage_gaps.description: The Kosovo business registry (ARBK/KBRA, arbk.rks-gov.net) was not searched in this slice; it records statutory directors and authorised representatives and would give a legally authoritative, machine-checkable view of leadership changes at each bank entity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an ARBK company-search pass per bank legal entity (Sh.a. names) to capture director changes independent of whether the bank publicises them.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group regulated disclosure channels were only partly mapped: RBI (Vienna) for Raiffeisen, BNP Paribas/TEB Türkiye (KAP filings) for TEB, Ziraat Bankası (Ankara) for Ziraat and BKT's Turkish owner Çalık were not individually enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map each bank's parent IR/press channel, including Borsa Istanbul KAP disclosures for TEB and any Turkish-owned entity, since subsidiary CEO appointments are frequently disclosed at parent level first.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-yield channels for leadership and hiring signals (LinkedIn and Facebook) are login-walled and ToS-restricted, so automated collection is not permitted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for analyst-assisted manual review of the eight banks' LinkedIn/Facebook pages, or procure a licensed social-listening feed; do not build scrapers.

coverage_gaps.description: None of the identified Albanian-language portals were confirmed to expose a date-bounded or paginated archive suitable for historical backfill of appointments and restructurings; Telegrafi tag pages are the only verified archive structure, and Koha's archive path is 403-blocked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test tag/category pagination depth on telegrafi.com, ekonomiaonline.com and buletiniekonomik.com; where pagination is shallow, backfill via a web-archive (Wayback) crawl of the same category URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: Two of the seven outlets named in the cell brief — Indeksonline and (for a canonical domain) Gazeta Express — were not evidenced as banking-leadership sources in this pass; Zëri was confirmed only at homepage/section level, not with a banking-personnel article.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run site-restricted crawls of indeksonline.com, gazetaexpress.com and zeri.info using the A5 verb set to confirm or retire each before allocating collection resources.

coverage_gaps.description: Discovery skewed heavily toward leadership moves and dismissals. Rank-and-file 'jobs / hiring' signal (branch hiring waves, headcount cuts, vacancy volumes) appeared only as aggregate statistics republished from BQK, never as outlet-originated reporting in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat the media cell as the leadership-moves channel and route rank-and-file jobs/hiring signal to the job-board and regulator cells; add Albanian-language recruitment-ad monitoring on the portals' own classified sections (e.g. KosovaJob) as a complementary feed.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo bank leadership is thin and largely politically framed; sr searches returned Serbia-domestic banking appointments (Komercijalna banka, Direktna Banka) rather than Kosovo-market bank management events.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Keep sr sources (KoSSev, Kosovo Online tag 'izvršni direktor') on a low-frequency schedule scoped to north-Kosovo branch and parallel-institution events, and do not expect them to cover Prishtina-headquartered commercial banks.

coverage_gaps.description: Only one RSS endpoint was confirmed advertised across the whole cell (ekonomiaonline.com/feed/). RSS availability for Telegrafi, Koha, Zëri, Klan Kosova, Kallxo, Insajderi and Nacionale is untested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe /feed/, /rss, /feed/rss2 and sitemap.xml on every candidate domain; prefer sitemaps for archive discovery where RSS is absent, and reserve HTML scraping for the remainder.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell mixes a high-credibility investigative platform (KALLXO/BIRN) with allegation-driven portals (Paparaci) whose reporting on bank executives is materially useful but unverified, and outlet ownership ties are not yet mapped onto the source list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the Media Ownership Monitor Kosovo outlet/company tables once and attach an ownership-derived credibility weight to each source; enforce a two-independent-source rule before any leadership-change event from a sub-0.5 credibility outlet enters the record.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-side primary sources for this cell are thin: no branch-locator dataset, careers page, or annual report was actually opened for Poštanska štedionica or NLB Komercijalna banka in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve and register the two banks' corporate sites; set up periodic diffing of their branch/expozitura locators, which is the cleanest machine-readable organization-change signal available for the dinar dimension.

coverage_gaps.description: No Kosovo-side registry check was made for whether Serbian-licensed banks or their staff-serving entities appear in Kosovo's business registry (ARBK) or CBK licensed-institution list under sr-transliterated names.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-check ARBK and CBK/BQK licensed-institution lists for Serbian-name entities and transliterations (Poštanska/Postanska/Poshtanska), which would convert media claims into registry-grade evidence.

coverage_gaps.description: Most retrieved evidence clusters around the 2024 dinar ban and branch closures; little 2025-2026 material surfaced despite the current date being August 2026.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell's queries with explicit 2025/2026 date constraints and directly on KoSSev/Kosovo Online site search, to establish whether coverage genuinely thinned or search recency bias suppressed it.

coverage_gaps.description: All queries were run in Latin-script Serbian; Cyrillic-script variants (Поштанска штедионица, филијала, запослени, именован директор) were not attempted, and Politika/RTS/kim.gov.rs publish substantially in Cyrillic.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Duplicate the query set in Cyrillic and add script-normalisation (Latin<->Cyrillic transliteration) to the collector's matching layer.

coverage_gaps.description: Several enclave outlets (notably RTV KIM) appear to distribute primarily via Facebook, which is not collectable under normal scraping constraints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide a policy for social-first local outlets — permitted API access, manual review cadence, or explicit exclusion documented as a known blind spot.

coverage_gaps.description: Only a handful of the 100+ STIKK member companies were examined; the full set of Kosovo integrators with banking practices has not been enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a one-off full crawl of stikk.org/en/members/*, classify each member by whether it names financial-services clients, and promote the banking-relevant subset to individually tracked sources.

coverage_gaps.description: ATM/self-service hardware OEMs (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf) and PIN-pad/POS OEMs (Verifone, Ingenico, PAX) were not individually searched for Kosovo partners or press releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query each OEM's partner locator and newsroom with country filters for Kosovo/Albania and add their authorised local partners as candidates.

coverage_gaps.description: The Kosovo Business Registration Agency (ARBK/KBRA) was not queried to confirm which foreign banking-technology vendors hold Kosovo legal entities and who their registered directors are.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an ARBK entity lookup step for every vendor name in the actor map; registered-director changes are a legally-filed leadership-move signal that bypasses corporate PR entirely.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — where vendor country-manager and new-hire announcements for this region overwhelmingly live — is only partially covered and is ToS-constrained.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a compliant analyst workflow (manual review or licensed data) for a watchlist of vendor company pages and Kosovo-based employee profiles, rather than attempting automated collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference sponsor and speaker lists (Kosovo Banking Association forums, Technobank, regional payments events) were identified as a mechanism but individual event pages and agendas were not harvested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Collect agendas and sponsor rosters for the last three years of Kosovo Banking Association events and Technobank; extract vendor names and speaker job titles as a combined vendor-map and leadership-move dataset.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language job-board coverage relied on one board (KosovaJob); other Kosovo boards were not checked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add portalpune.com, ngo-jobs / telegrafi job sections and Gjirafa's job vertical to the daily hiring crawl with the same sq keyword set.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of banking events, training and university pipeline inside Kosovo is nearly absent from this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sr-only pass targeting: the official domain of Ekonomski fakultet Univerziteta u Prištini (Kosovska Mitrovica), Kosovo-north Serbian-language news outlets (KoSSev, Radio Kim, Gracanicaonline), and Serbian banks operating branches/services in the north; also search 'stručna praksa', 'konkurs za stipendije', 'gostujuće predavanje banka'.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-bank event/careers pages were only established for Raiffeisen and ProCredit. TEB, BKT Kosova, NLB Banka, Banka Ekonomike, BPB and the payment institutions have no enumerated internship/graduate/event source in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the BQK licensed-institutions PDF as the seed list and systematically enumerate each institution's /karriera, /lajme and /media pages in sq and en, plus their KosovaJob employer page.

coverage_gaps.description: Private and non-public universities with strong bank ties — UBT College, RIT Kosovo (A.U.K.), Riinvest College, AAB, European College of Kosovo — were not individually covered, despite being the likeliest hosts of bank-sponsored career fairs, guest lectures and graduate schemes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-institution pass on career-centre and news pages for 'panair i punës', 'praktikë', 'memorandum bashkëpunimi' + bank names; RIT Kosovo and Riinvest in particular publish English-language employer partnership news.

coverage_gaps.description: Speaker rosters and agendas are ephemeral: organiser sites typically replace them per edition, and no archival strategy is yet defined for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) snapshot-and-retrieval step for kosovabusinessforum.com/speaker/, bqk-kos.org agenda pages and KosICT speaker microsites, and trigger a live capture in the two weeks before and after each known event date.

coverage_gaps.description: Donor and IFI training/capacity-building programmes (EBRD Women in Business, IFC advisory, GIZ, Deutsche Sparkassenstiftung, EU Office in Kosovo traineeships) touch this cell — they fund bank training and internship schemes and their press releases name bank counterparts — but were only glimpsed indirectly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout ebrd.com, ifc.org, giz.de/kosovo, sparkassenstiftung.de and eeas.europa.eu/kosovo project and press pages for Kosovo banking-sector training and internship projects; the KBA–Deutsche Sparkassenstiftung MoU (March 2026) is a confirmed entry point.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidate URLs in this slice are constructed or inferred from search snippets (e.g. the KBA /trainings/ index, amchamksv.org events path) rather than fetched, and one Serbian-language entry is a third-party directory standing in for an unlocated official domain.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidates through the deterministic liveness pass; for any 404, resolve the correct path by crawling the site root rather than marking the source dead.

coverage_gaps.description: BSPK's member-union directory was not enumerated, so it is unconfirmed whether any affiliate covers financial services (e.g. a services or commerce union that banks would fall under).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch bspk.org member-union list and each affiliate's contact page; snowball on any services/commerce/finance affiliate and its officials' names.

coverage_gaps.description: Court judgment repositories were identified but not searched for bank defendants in employment disputes; per-court coverage beyond Prishtina (Prizren, Peja, Gjilan, Ferizaj, Mitrovica, Gjakova) is unmapped, as is the Court of Appeals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate all Basic Court subdomains on gjyqesori-rks.org, harvest verdict PDFs, and build a keyword index on the ten licensed banks plus 'kontest pune'.

coverage_gaps.description: No baseline snapshot of ARBK records for each licensed bank and its registered branch units was taken, so branch-closure and authorised-person changes cannot yet be detected by diffing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Take an initial ARBK snapshot per bank entity (directors, authorised persons, registered units) and schedule monthly diffs; check whether eKosova login is required for full extracts.

coverage_gaps.description: Employee-voice channels beyond Glassdoor were not surveyed: LinkedIn departure/tenure signals, local Facebook groups where dismissed Kosovo bank staff discuss cases, and any Albanian-language forum equivalents.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Survey LinkedIn company pages of Kosovo banks for headcount and departure patterns, and identify the main Albanian-language employment/complaint Facebook groups; assess terms and feasibility for each.

coverage_gaps.description: The specific Labour Law provisions and administrative instructions governing collective redundancy thresholds and mandatory notification to the Labour Inspectorate and APRK were not retrieved, so the trigger conditions that would make a bank restructuring officially visible are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the Labour Law and relevant administrative instructions from gzk.rks-gov.net and extract notification thresholds, deadlines and recipient institutions.

coverage_gaps.description: APRK and SITP were identified but not queried at the NACE-K (financial and insurance activities) level; it is unconfirmed whether their published breakdowns go deep enough to isolate banking headcount and jobseeker inflows.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query SITP and APRK bulletins for financial-activity breakdowns; if unavailable publicly, prepare an official information request to APRK/ASK.

coverage_gaps.description: International labour-rights monitors that document Kosovo (ITUC Global Rights Index, ILO country pages, European Commission Kosovo Report labour chapter) were not searched in this run and may carry systematic assessments of anti-union practice relevant to bank employers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search ITUC, ILO and EC enlargement-report sources for Kosovo labour-rights and social-dialogue findings; add as credibility anchors.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language regional aggregator/analyst layer (as opposed to Kosovo daily news, which sits in other cells) was not identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sq specifically for Albania-based financial analysis outlets (e.g. Monitor, Scan, AAB Albania association) that cover both Albanian and Kosovar bank groups; add terms 'emërime në krye të bankës', 'ndryshime në bordin drejtues', 'bashkim bankash'.

coverage_gaps.description: Credit rating agency and equity-analyst commentary (Fitch, Moody's, S&P, plus parent-group investor relations) on Kosovo subsidiaries' governance and management changes was not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on rating-agency press releases and parent-bank IR/annual reports (ProCredit Holding, Raiffeisen Bank International, NLB Group, BNP Paribas/TEB, Ziraat, İşbank) for Kosovo subsidiary board composition.

coverage_gaps.description: Emerging Europe's actual Kosovo output is unknown; no direct site search was performed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch emerging-europe.com site search for 'Kosovo bank', 'Kosovo fintech', 'Kosovo appointment' and record real article URLs or a definitive negative.

coverage_gaps.description: Professional-network and job-board aggregation (LinkedIn company pages for CBK and Kosovo banks, regional recruiter reports) is the densest source of people moves but is legally and technically constrained.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess legal/ToS position for LinkedIn-derived signals; otherwise substitute conference speaker lists, association board pages and bank 'management' pages as the diffable structured proxy.

coverage_gaps.description: No archive strategy established for paywalled newswire items (SeeNews, IntelliNews) whose historical appointment records are the most valuable back-series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test archive.org and Google News cache coverage for these domains; consider a licensed feed if back-series proves essential.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-yield parent-group disclosure languages for this cell are Slovene (NLB/SEOnet), German (ProCredit Holding, RBI ad-hoc) and Turkish (KAP, TEB, Ziraat) — none of which are in the declared sq/sr/en language set.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the run's language set to include sl, de and tr for workstream A5 cell 3, or accept a systematic lag behind local-language pickup.

coverage_gaps.description: Statutory portals (KAP for TEB/Turkish entities, SEOnet for NLB, and the German Bundesanzeiger/EQS pipeline for ProCredit Holding and RBI) were identified but not queried through their own interfaces within this scouting pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build issuer-scoped queries directly against KAP, SEOnet and EQS/Bundesanzeiger rather than relying on general web search indexing.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo's central bank (BQK/CBK) approves bank senior-management appointments, so its approvals/licensing register would corroborate or pre-date parent-group announcements; that regulator branch sits outside this cell and was not scouted here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another coverage cell scouts BQK/CBK approval notices and cross-link them to the parent-group releases catalogued here.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is strong on leadership/structural signals but essentially empty on 'jobs/hiring' — parent groups do not advertise Kosovo-unit vacancies on group IR channels.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route hiring-volume signals to career-portal and job-board cells (group career sites, subsidiary career pages, LinkedIn jobs), and treat this cell as leadership/structure only.

coverage_gaps.description: Other foreign owners with Kosovo banking/payments exposure (e.g. the Albanian and Turkish owners of smaller Kosovo banks and non-bank financial institutions) were not enumerated within the six named actors of this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map from the Kosovo bank licence register to catch every foreign-parent entity, then repeat this cell's method for each.

coverage_gaps.description: No Serbian-language hiring or corporate source specific to payments employers operating in Kosovo was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sr-only scouting pass over Kosovo-Serb outlets (KoSSev, Kosovo Online, Radio Kim, Gracanica Online) and over Serbian job boards filtered for 'platni promet' and 'kartično poslovanje'; also check the Serbian NBS register for entities operating in northern Kosovo.

coverage_gaps.description: The full census of BQK-licensed non-bank payment and e-money institutions has not yet been enumerated — only the register's location was identified, not parsed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Parse the dated BQK licensed-institutions PDF to extract every IFJB / payment institution / e-money institution, then scout each entity's own careers page, social channels and ARBK record as first-class sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Recruitment intermediaries (headhunters, HR agencies, staffing firms) placing payments/fintech roles in Kosovo were not scouted, nor were university/bootcamp career portals that carry employer-branded intake programmes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Kosovo HR/recruitment agencies and the career offices of UP, RIT Kosovo/AUK and UBT, plus STIKK (ICT association) member and job channels, for payments-employer demand signals.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership-move evidence is currently thin: no systematic source of executive appointments at Kosovo payments firms was established beyond registry officer fields and ad-hoc news.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish a two-track leadership feed: (a) quarterly ARBK/OpenCorporates.al officer diffs for the payments watchlist, (b) analyst monitoring of company LinkedIn/Facebook plus The Kosovo Banker interviews. Treat FIKS governance changes as a proxy signal.

coverage_gaps.description: Several of the highest-value channels (LinkedIn company pages for Paysera Kosova, PayLink, Swinto; Facebook for OneFor) are login-walled and ToS-restrictive.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide a compliant access policy — licensed API, analyst-in-the-loop manual review, or exclusion — before building collection; do not scrape. Compensate by weighting company websites, job boards and registries more heavily.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo bank/PSP hiring is effectively absent - no Kosovo-specific sr board exists and Serbia-wide boards show only thin Kosovska Mitrovica pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test whether northern-Kosovo financial employers advertise via Serbian municipal/community channels, Facebook groups for Kosovska Mitrovica, or the Serbia-wide boards' employer pages; if not, formally mark the sr hiring dimension as uncovered rather than assumed covered.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership moves and executive departures are not carried by any board in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route the 'leadership moves' topic to regulator (BQK fit-and-proper / licensing), company press-release and business-media cells; treat this cell's output as unit/system change only.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell covers third-party boards only. Bank and PSP first-party career pages (e.g. procreditbank-kos.com, bkt-ks.com, teb-kos.com, nlb-kos.com, raiffeisen-kosovo.com, bpbbank.com, bankaekonomike.com, ziraatbank.com.tr KS, Paysera Kosove) were identified as existing employers but their own /karriera pages were not enumerated here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a companion sub-cell that enumerates each licensed bank/PSP career page and its ATS (Workday/SmartRecruiters/etc.), since senior and technical roles often appear there first and never reach the boards.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank PSPs, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions (the fastest-changing organizations in payments) are under-represented in what the boards surfaced; only FINCA, Capital and a few appeared. The BQK register of licensed non-bank payment service providers was not cross-walked against board employer directories.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the BQK list of licensed banks, MFIs and non-bank PSPs and resolve each to its employer page on kosovajob.com/kastori.net; treat any licensed entity with no board presence as a first-party-only recruiter.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical archive of expired Kosovo bank vacancies was found, so no baseline exists before collection starts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin snapshotting full ad text immediately; probe the Wayback Machine for kosovajob.com/ofertapune.net employer pages to back-fill a partial baseline, and mine njoftime.com's persistent threads for older bank ads.

coverage_gaps.description: portalpune.com's 403 was not resolved, and aprk.rks-gov.net's vacancy search may be behind registration. duapune.com, gjejpune.org and shpalljepune.com were catalogued from search metadata without a depth probe.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser retry pass over these five domains before assigning final access_status; do not let the deterministic liveness pass mark portalpune.com dead on the 403 alone.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's primary platform (LinkedIn) is auth-walled and ToS-restricted, so no automated collector can be built against it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide between (a) a logged-in human-analyst weekly sweep with a fixed watchlist of ~15 company pages, (b) LinkedIn Sales Navigator job-change alerts on a curated list of Kosovo banking/payments executives, or (c) a licensed third-party people-data vendor. Do not build a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn company pages were confirmed for ProCredit, Raiffeisen, NLB, TEB, BKT but not for Banka Ekonomike, Banka për Biznes (BpB), Ziraat Bank Kosova, or the microfinance/NBFI layer (KEP Trust, Agroinvest, Kredi Rapid).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run an in-app LinkedIn company search for each licensed institution on the CBK register and complete the watchlist; NBFIs matter for payments hiring.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-side (non-bank) actors are under-mapped: only Paysera, Paykos and the FIKS founder roster (Numarics, OneFor, Swinto) were identified; POS/acquiring vendors, PSPs and processing centres serving Kosovo are largely unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball each FIKS member page, plus CBK's register of payment institutions/EMIs, into individual LinkedIn page candidates; add Quipu and any regional processors serving Kosovo banks.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language professional-network coverage produced no usable LinkedIn source specific to Kosovo.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Substitute sr-language open-web boards (klikdoposla, sljaka) and treat sr professional-network coverage as a known blind spot in the run's coverage statement.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-LinkedIn professional/social channels were not explored in this pass (Facebook job groups, which are heavily used in Kosovo; Instagram employer-branding accounts; local ICT association STIKK member communications).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up sweep for Facebook groups ('Punë në Kosovë'), STIKK, and employer Instagram/Facebook careers posts as LinkedIn substitutes with better accessibility.

coverage_gaps.description: All LinkedIn URLs in this slice are search-engine-reported and unverified for liveness; several were returned under country-subdomain forms (fj.linkedin.com, rs.linkedin.com) which are geo/locale variants, not canonical.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Normalise all LinkedIn URLs to www.linkedin.com canonical form during the deterministic verification pass; expect 999/403 responses that indicate bot defence rather than a dead URL.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage for this cell is thin. Searches in Serbian returned mostly Serbia/BiH registries rather than Kosovo-specific registry content, and no Serbian-language ARBK interface or Serbian-language Kosovo registry search terminology in active use was confirmed beyond the official name 'Kosovska Agencija za Registraciju Preduzeća'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sr-language queries against Kosovo-Serb media and north-Kosovo business coverage (e.g. 'ovlašćeno lice', 'promena direktora', 'izvod iz registra', combined with named banks) and check whether ARBK/GZK expose sr-language interfaces or documents.

coverage_gaps.description: No feed, RSS, notification service, or dated change log for Kosovo registry filings was identified. Change detection depends entirely on self-built snapshot diffing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prototype a per-entity snapshot-and-diff routine over the BQK licensed-institutions watchlist, with polite rate limits; investigate whether arbk.org's API exposes an updated-at or new-registrations endpoint that can act as a trigger.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell is well covered for licensed banks and financial institutions but weakly covered for their SUPPLIERS (POS/ATM vendors, IT integrators, cash-in-transit, card personalisation), whose registry records are the same but whose identities are not enumerated anywhere obvious.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use e-Prokurimi award notices and ARBK NACE-code filtering (arbk.org supports 615 NACE codes) to build a supplier watchlist, then apply the same officer-diff monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unclear whether ARBK exposes HISTORICAL extracts (prior officers, prior statutes) publicly or only 'current' extracts; secondary vendors describe extracts as 'relevant at the moment of the request'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm availability and cost of historical extracts directly with ARBK or via one extract broker on a single test entity; this determines whether backfill of leadership history is feasible at all.

coverage_gaps.description: Data-protection constraints on officer personal data and a reported prohibition on automated bulk extraction for commercial redistribution were noted but not read at source (law text / ARBK terms of use).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain and read ARBK's terms of use and the applicable Kosovo personal-data-protection provisions before designing any automated collection; record the permitted-use envelope in the source register.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-value source in this cell (e-Prokurimi notice corpus) has no confirmed machine-readable listing or API; only ID-addressed notice pages were confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated technical reconnaissance pass on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net with a headless browser: locate the notice-search form, capture its POST/query parameters and CPV filter values, and test whether notice IDs are densely sequential enough for enumeration. Consult the Open Contracting Partnership Kosovo assessment first.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo public financial institutions' vacancy and tender notices is essentially unconfirmed apart from Posta e Kosovës.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Visit the sr language toggles of mf.rks-gov.net, fsdk.org, fondikgk.org, trusti.org and e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net directly and record the sr URL patterns; add 'site:rks-gov.net' and 'Priština/Kosovo' qualifiers to all sr queries to suppress Republic-of-Serbia noise.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo's other public/state-linked financial actors were not systematically enumerated in this pass — e.g. the Privatisation Agency, publicly owned enterprises with treasury functions, the Tax Administration (ATK) and Customs (Dogana) as payment-collecting bodies. Dogana was seen publishing its own B08 award notices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Diff the KRPP 'Lista e Autoriteteve Kontraktuese' against the actors already tracked, and add any body whose mandate involves collecting, holding or disbursing public money.

coverage_gaps.description: Contract-implementation and payment-execution data (who was actually paid, how much, over what period) was not sourced; only notice-stage data was confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate whether contract 'implementation cards' referenced by the Open Contracting Partnership assessment are individually downloadable from e-Prokurimi, and whether Treasury publishes supplier payment records (a common open-data disclosure).

coverage_gaps.description: Several institutional vacancy pages (FSDK, Trusti, KCGF) appear to publish notices as dated PDFs but it is unconfirmed whether expired notices remain archived, so retrospective hiring-trend reconstruction may be impossible from the primary sources alone.
